title: EntityAnchorData v1
description: Owner-local EntityAnchor storage shape. This schema documents structural roots and stable keypath families only; it must not be used to publish values.

person.description: Owner-controlled person/profile data and domain slices. Use person.name for structured names, person.displayName for presentation, person.profile for human-facing profile leaves, person.addresses for address values, person.contact for contact values and endpoint descriptors, proofs.* for evidence bodies, and person.attributes[] for provisional namespaced attributes.

displayName.description: Human-facing display label; not necessarily legal identity.

legalName.description: Private legal or billing name when a purpose explicitly needs it.

profile.description: Human-facing profile leaves and references such as headline, bio, avatarRef, websiteURLs and sameAsRefs.

addresses.description: Address records selected by id or label, e.g. person.addresses[label="home"].street.name.

contact.description: Owner-local contact fields, multi-value email/phone arrays and public-safe contact endpoint descriptors.

location.description: Coarse location leaves such as city, region, country, countryCode, timezone and optional geoRef.

languages.description: Known/preferred language records, preferably with BCP 47-style tags.

demographics.description: Sensitive self-described person attributes such as birthDate, ageBand, pronouns, genderIdentity and nationalities.

work.description: Current work-facing profile fields and organization refs.

affiliations.description: Organization/program/community affiliations with optional proof refs.

skills.description: Claimed skill records with optional taxonomy and evidence refs.

preferences.description: Owner preferences for locale, communication and default visibility.

attributes.description: Namespaced provisional attributes for fields that are not stable enough for canonical keypaths yet.

relations.description: Local relations, linked identities, issuers, private people records and public-safe contact endpoint descriptors.

proofs.description: Local proof records such as identity links, inclusion proofs, admission contracts and membership proofs.

signedAgreementEntity.description: Canonical signed agreement records. May contain sensitive grants and counterparties.

entityRepresentation.description: Entity-shaped representation one Entity holds about another Entity, using comparable EntityAnchorData keypaths while keeping private values, relation graphs and chronicle history behind grants.

agreements.description: Derived agreement indexes. Do not edit directly.

bindings.description: Route/binding metadata for how entity data maps to cells and scaffolds.

$comment: JSON fra kildekodens dokumenterte struktur. Swift-strengen mister escaping rundt home i en beskrivelse; denne filen bevarer gyldig JSON. Se runtime-output.txt og LES-MEG.md.
